title.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
title.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed

current_state.zh: Kimi released K3.1 Pro and a K3.1 Pro Highspeed variant, pairing the launch with a stated policy of withholding open weights where they would push the frontier of offensive cyber capability, while commenters reported aggressive subscription quota limits and debated the open-weights rationale.
